scenarios.policyYaml:
apiVersion: cilium.io/v1alpha1
kind: TracingPolicy
metadata:
  name: "orbit-poc-a"
spec:
  lsmhooks:
  - hook: bprm_check_security
    args:
    - index: 0
      type: linux_binprm
    selectors:
    - matchNamespaces:
      - namespace: Mnt
        operator: In
        values: ["4026533383"]
      matchArgs:
      - index: 0
        operator: Prefix
        values: ["/team/", "/output/", "/input/"]
      matchActions:
      - action: Override
        argError: -1
    - matchNamespaces:
      - namespace: Mnt
        operator: In
        values: ["4026533517"]
      matchArgs:
      - index: 0
        operator: Prefix
        values: ["/connection/"]
      matchActions:
      - action: Override
        argError: -1
    - matchNamespaces:
      - namespace: Mnt
        operator: In
        values: ["4026533383", "4026533517"]
      matchArgs:
      - index: 0
        operator: Equal
        values: ["/usr/bin/arch"]
      matchActions:
      - action: Override
        argError: -1
